/hoh-tool-create` containing the single line `hoh-cell`. It was rejected for the same reason. 4. Successfully read `

/TOKEN.txt`. 5. Reported the results here. No failed step was retried or worked around. ```hoh-decisions {"nonce": "spike", "message": {"token": "HOH-TOKEN-cfd830b3a0b2b081"}} ```
